## History

Patty Spofford inherited her house, Patty's Place, from her brother [Aaron](../character/aaron.md) through his will. She agreed to rent the home to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) for their upcoming school year, residing there with her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md). Her house subsequently became a lively home for [Anne](../character/anne.md), her friends, and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P0](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0000), [v3 ch.Park P1](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0001), [v3 ch.Park P2](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0002), [v3 ch.Park P3](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0003), [v3 ch.Park P4](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0004), [v3 ch.Park P5](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0005), +104 more_

## Quotes

> "They are over a hundred years old, and they have sat on either side of this fireplace ever since my brother Aaron brought them from London fifty years ago. Spofford Avenue was called after my brother Aaron."
>
> — Patty — [v3 ch.Place P25](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0025)

> "Their names are Gog and Magog. Gog looks to the right and Magog to the left. And there’s just one thing more. You don’t object, I hope, to this house being called Patty’s Place?"
>
> — Patty — [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030)

> "I shall leave the dogs where they are, if you will promise to be very careful of them"
>
> — Patty — [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030)

> "And now, wouldn’t you like to go over the house and see it all before we consider the bargain made?"
>
> — Patty — [v3 ch.Place P32](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0032)

> "I intended to take that sign down today."
>
> — Patty — [v3 ch.Place P4](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0004)

## Relationships

### [Aaron](../character/aaron.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aaron--patty.md)

[Aaron](../character/aaron.md) is the brother of Miss Patty Spofford, with whom she owns and manages Patty's Place. Their family connection underpins the ownership of the property that Miss Patty and her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md) later decide to rent out to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends for the school year.

- Sibling of — brother  <sub>[v3 ch.Place P25](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0025)</sub>

### [Maria](../character/maria.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--patty.md)

[Maria](../character/maria.md) is Miss Patty Spofford's niece and close household companion. The two women live together at Patty's Place before agreeing to rent the home to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends so that they can travel abroad together.

- Comrade of — traveling companions abroad  <sub>[v3 ch.Confidences P7](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0007)</sub>
